categories.main_business_segments: Meituan operates primarily in two segments: Core local commerce and New initiatives. Core local commerce includes food delivery, Meituan Instashopping, in-store services, hotel and travel booking businesses. New initiatives cover emerging businesses such as grocery retail, B2B food distribution, bike sharing, e-moped sharing, power banks, and restaurant SaaS services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital platforms and mobile applications to facilitate on-demand delivery and retail services. It invests heavily in technology innovations including AI, autonomous delivery vehicles, drones, and cloud computing. Meituan also employs supply chain innovations and digital tools to enhance merchant operations and consumer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Meituan serves a broad consumer base in local services including individual consumers ordering food, groceries, and other retail products, as well as merchants across various sectors such as restaurants, retail stores, hotels, and travel service providers. The company also targets B2B customers through its food distribution and SaaS services. Its markets are primarily in China with expanding overseas presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are mainly concentrated in Mainland China, with headquarters in Beijing and significant presence in Shanghai, Chengdu, Shijiazhuang, Wuhan, Shenzhen, and other cities. Meituan has also expanded into overseas markets, notably Saudi Arabia, with plans for further global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meituan operates primarily downstream in the supply chain as a platform connecting consumers with merchants and service providers. It facilitates transactions and delivery services but also engages in midstream activities such as B2B food distribution and supply chain innovations to support merchants.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing digital transformation and technology-driven retail, emphasizing AI, autonomous delivery, drones, and cloud computing. It prioritizes innovation in on-demand delivery, supply chain efficiency, and ecosystem sustainability. Meituan also invests in social responsibility initiatives including courier welfare and environmental sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Meituan generates revenue through multiple streams including delivery service fees, commissions from merchants and third-party partners, online marketing services, and sales of goods and services in new initiatives. It also earns interest revenue and income from various financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not detailed in the report, Meituan positions itself as a leading platform in local services and on-demand delivery in China, with a strong market presence and diversified service offerings. It competes in sectors such as food delivery, retail, hotel and travel booking, and emerging mobility services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Meituan reported revenues of RMB 337.6 billion in 2024, a 22.0% increase from 2023, with operating profit rising to RMB 36.8 billion. The Core local commerce segment showed strong profitability with a 20.9% operating margin. The company’s profit for the year was RMB 35.8 billion, reflecting significant growth. It holds substantial cash reserves and investments, supporting ongoing expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meituan emphasizes technology-driven convenience, efficiency, and affordability in local services. Its value proposition includes a comprehensive ecosystem that integrates food delivery, retail, in-store services, and travel, supported by advanced digital tools and supply chain innovations. The company focuses on enhancing user experience, merchant empowerment, and sustainable development, differentiating itself through scale, technology, and service diversity.
